Reasoning: Qinghai is located in the northeastern part of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, and the greater precipitation on the southeastern edge is related to water vapor transported by the summer monsoon. Therefore, the water vapor for the greater precipitation on the southeastern edge of Qinghai Province mainly comes from the Indian Ocean.
